improvement_detail: n = 10^7 - simulation 8.28 s, recursion 9.3e-5 s; n = 10^6 - 0.85 s vs 7.1e-5 s (CPython, loaded machine; order of magnitude only). Correctness of the recursion beyond the tested n is conjectural (CLM-C19-05); the simulation remains the reference method.
novelty_basis: No sublinear method for the longest game was found in the literature listed under CLM-C19-05.
statement: The recursion of CLM-C19-05 evaluates L(n) with O(log^2 n) arithmetic operations; the published method (playing the split-first game) needs L(n) ~ phi^2 n moves. On the tested range both agree.
title: Computing the longest game in O(log^2 n) operations instead of simulating Theta(n) moves
